name: lovableseo-agent-plugin
description: Diagnose technical SEO in Lovable and React projects by comparing saved raw HTML with the rendered DOM. Inspect titles, canonicals, robots directives and links, then verify a targeted repair. Includes a local Python comparator. No account connection, telemetry or ranking promises.

interface.longDescription: Diagnose technical SEO in Lovable and React projects by comparing saved raw HTML with the rendered DOM. Inspect titles, canonicals, robots directives and links, then verify a targeted repair. Includes a local Python comparator. No account connection, telemetry or ranking promises.
defaultPrompt: Compare this page’s raw HTML with its rendered DOM.
Find and fix the canonical error in my React route.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with a local checker, controlled fixtures and explicit runtime verification limits.
